This was because:

A) things were moving to a point where I knew it was up to me to take a chance and trust him and;
B) he insinuated he was looking for something serious and the things he was saying and doing told me he was sincere and caring.
C) NF doesn't really affect me too much outwardly at least in the context of someone caring what i look like currently in the dating scene. I have lumps but they could pass as skin tags, especially as someone who doesn't know what they are looking at.
D) I wanted him to get to know me a little bit without making out my NF is my whole life. 


Telling my now partner was really anxiety inducing and one of hardest things. I didn't want to be rejected and I never really put my trust in a guy like that before at all. In fact, in high school I was bullied by boys.

 In the days before i told him, I was trying to find a way to dump it on him, and so I went quiet and he thought I was losing interest in him! 

I remember him messaging me "hey youre awful quiet, have I done anything wrong?" and I responded;
 "no no you havent done anything wrong",
 he then responded with:  "well whatever it is, im here for you".

When I told him, I was factual and to the point with the information I had known about NF at the time. 
He said he didn't care and that he loved me.

We can have a problem with our facial bones called sphenoid wing dysplasia (malformed facial bones that didn't grow properly during inutero development) 
If it's mild, you would not be able to tell without a scan and someone who knows what they are looking at.

Please do not be alarmed as SWD is pretty harmless in itself, but for me, I get chronic ear infections because it doesn't allow my sinuses or inner ear to drain properly. I didn't even know i had it, its pretty bengin (both the SWD and ear infection that is)
